_source: Hand-written to the Messages API response shape (a forced record_daily_answer tool_use, stop_reason, usage); not captured from the live API. The boats and counts are the made-up rows tests/test_advisor_daily.mjs seeds; the landing trip and the advisory come from tests/fixtures/feeds/.
description: Morro Bay, Mon 28 Sep 2026 with no skipper report in three days: the answer says so and falls back to the landing's Starfire trip with its Low label, attributed to the landing.

input.en: Morro Bay, Mon Sep 28: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY posted for today. No skipper reports from the last three days. The landing reports Starfire on Sun with bocaccio, copper rockfish and 8 lingcod; recent reported activity: Low. Seas 7 ft at 17 s, wind 15-19 kt from the NW, rough for a mid-size center console. Full picture: {{link:port:morro-bay}}
input.es: Morro Bay, lun 28 sept: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY (aviso del NWS) para hoy. No hay reportes de capitanes de los últimos tres días. El muelle reporta al Starfire el dom con bocaccio, rocote cobrizo y 8 lingcod; actividad reciente reportada: Low. Mar de 7 pies a 17 s, viento de 15-19 nudos del NW, duro para una lancha mediana. Todo el detalle: {{link:port:morro-bay}}
